title: Quanfluence raises $10 million to build full-stack photonic quantum computer
source_used: Entrackr (Economic Times page returned no text)
key_facts: Bengaluru startup Quanfluence raised $10 million in a round led by Chiratae Ventures, with Rainmatter by Zerodha and Pi Ventures
It had raised $2 million in a seed round in December 2024
Money will build and launch a four-qubit quantum computer in the near term, with a roughly 100-qubit prototype targeted by 2029
Aims for a fault-tolerant general-purpose machine in five to six years
Photonic system works at room temperature, using light and FPGAs in an optical Ising machine for optimisation problems
Company claims up to 100 times faster than classical computing for certain workloads
Funding details come from the company's press release
quote_evidence: The fresh funds will be used to build and launch a four-qubit quantum computer in the near term, with the company targeting a larger prototype featuring around 100 qubits by 2029, Quanfluence said in a press release.
The startup's system is designed to address high-dimensional optimisation problems.
why_it_matters_hint: A small funding round for a startup that has only announced a four-qubit target so far.
